caption: The drawing features a single crescent-shaped or collar-like object centered on a beige or light tan background. The object has an intricate border composed of delicate floral and leafy motifs drawn in fine lines with some areas of stippling, all in a dark, monochromatic color, likely black or dark gray. The interior space of the collar is empty, with only the border decorated. In the lower left area of the background, outside the main shape, there are two small sketches: one is a cluster of tiny round elements with leaves attached, and the other is a similar leafy motif. There is a faint inscription of text in the lower right corner of the background, written in small letters. The overall composition is minimal and detailed, with the decorated collar centrally placed and the background left mostly blank.
title: Collar
